text: Based on the evidence, **yes**, this forest has remained largely intact since 2020. The JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset confirms **91.8% of the area was forest in 2020**, and the Hansen Global Forest Change data shows no significant loss events (minimum detectable: 0.5 ha) between 2020 and 2025. The analysis used a tree-cover threshold of ≥30%, consistent with both datasets. No disturbances meeting the corroboration rules were detected. The latest observation (2025) aligns with the 2020 baseline, confirming stability.
